verdict.rationale: Docs confirm agents present a structured plan showing each implementation step (codegen-docs-22), suggesting some plan visibility, but there is no evidence of a gating/approval workflow requiring developer sign-off before code changes are made — agents can create PRs and commit code seemingly autonomously (codegen-docs-24, codegen-docs-4). missing for 10: explicit approval/gate mechanism before execution, UI/CLI flow for approving or rejecting a plan, confirmation that code changes are blocked until plan is approved, independent/hands-on corroboration.
